fusions.name: Slow Roll of Musk
fusions.desc: Rolls out a slow-drifting glob of musk that deals 12 damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles and knocks it back 2.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Cloud
fusions.desc: Breathes out a cone of musk 4 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves it [Slowed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Urgent
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to hold every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds and leave each enemy caught [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gentle Recovery
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
